Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly asserted that the “over 60 million casualties” figure pertains to World War I and shifted the solution toward WWI, misreading/overstating Britannica’s WWI figures. This contradicted earlier correct reasoning and widely accepted history that “over 60 million” is associated with World War II. The Planner also over-relied on a single War Memorials Online entry listing only WWI and ignored corroborating sources showing the memorial commemorates both WWI and WWII, leading toward the wrong final answer.
